latestVersion.changelog:
ClawDiscover 1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Agent-focused service discovery platform with push-based updates.
- Free and paid API endpoints for discovering, browsing, and subscribing to new agent tools.
- Support for category filtering and AI-generated TL;DRs for services.
- Webhook and heartbeat integration guidance for automated, periodic checks.
- Built-in support for x402 micropayments and premium service feeds.
- Simple service submission process for developers.
